description: This file provides utility functions for managing file storage across local filesystem, AWS S3, and Google Cloud Storage, including uploading, downloading, listing, and deleting files and folders, with support for fallback mechanisms and size calculations.

methods.name: dirSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of a directory recursively in bytes.

methods.name: _sanitizeFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filename by removing leading dots and unsafe characters.

methods.name: _deleteLocalFolderRecursive
methods.description: Recursively deletes a local directory and its contents.

methods.name: _deleteS3Folder
methods.description: Recursively deletes all objects within an S3 folder/prefix.

methods.name: _cleanEmptyS3Folders
methods.description: Deletes empty S3 folders recursively based on prefix.

methods.name: _cleanEmptyGCSFolders
methods.description: Deletes empty GCS folders recursively based on prefix.
